x-ectwin.runs_in: Commons job catalog-triage (one-off backfill in ectwin-commons-dev, then weekly deltas in prod)

placeholders.source_portal: Portal id from the harvest, e.g. 'geonode.ciifen.org', 'geoservicios.inamhi.gob.ec', 'gestionderiesgos.gob.ec/biblioteca', 'datosabiertos.gob.ec/mag'
placeholders.title: Layer or document title (verbatim)
placeholders.abstract: Abstract or description, verbatim, max 1,500 characters
placeholders.category: Portal category or topic as published
placeholders.license_text: Licence or constraints text as published, or empty string
placeholders.attribution: Owner or attribution text as published
placeholders.extent_bucket: Bucket from code using the bounding box and INEC DPA: 'national', 'multi-province', 'province: X', 'canton or city: Y', 'site', 'outside Ecuador', 'no extent'
placeholders.date_bucket: Bucket from code using metadata dates: '2025-2026', '2020-2024', '2010-2019', 'before 2010', 'undated'

code_decides_without_jev: Spatial scale (from the bounding box), currency (from dates), format and service type, duplicate detection by normalised title and bounding-box overlap.
notes: Licence labels are only candidates: commercial_ok in layer_registry and catalog/data-sources.yaml is set by a human (D15).
Theme labels mirror the hazard / exposure / vulnerability / impact structure of docs/05-data-catalog.md (to align).

relevant_to_twin.instructions: Is `layer` useful for anticipating or managing El Nino impacts in Ecuador, as a hazard, exposure, vulnerability, impact, response or essential baseline layer?

criteria.true: Floods, landslides, coastal hazards, rainfall or ocean conditions, population, buildings, infrastructure, agriculture, aquaculture, health, energy, administrative limits, hydrography or response resources
criteria.false: Unrelated topics such as tourism promotion, cultural heritage only, internal administrative documents or empty test layers

criteria.amenaza_inundacion: Flood hazard, flood extent or flood susceptibility
criteria.amenaza_movimiento_masa: Landslide or mass-movement hazard or susceptibility
criteria.amenaza_costera: Coastal hazards: swell, tides, sea level, tsunami
criteria.clima_observado: Observed or reanalysis climate: rainfall, temperature, stations
criteria.clima_pronostico: Forecasts, seasonal outlooks or climate scenarios
criteria.enso_oceano: El Nino / ENSO indices or ocean conditions
criteria.exposicion_infraestructura: Roads, bridges, buildings, schools, health facilities, utilities
criteria.exposicion_agro_acuicultura: Crops, livestock, land use, shrimp farms, fisheries
criteria.vulnerabilidad_social: Poverty, social vulnerability or capacity indicators
criteria.hidrografia: Rivers, basins, drainage network, water bodies
criteria.respuesta_recursos: Shelters, evacuation routes, safe zones, response resources

hazard_pathway.instructions: Which El Nino hazard pathway in Ecuador is `layer` most relevant to?

criteria.coast_floods_health_agri: Coastal pathway: floods, landslides, coastal flooding, dengue, agriculture and aquaculture, roads
criteria.andes_amazon_hydro_energy: Andes and Amazon pathway: reservoir inflows, hydropower, drought

data_nature.instructions: What kind of data does `layer` contain?

criteria.inventory: Inventory of assets, events or facilities
criteria.document_only: A document, report or map image without usable data

licence_class.instructions: Based only on `layer.license_text` and `layer.attribution`, which licence class applies?

criteria.cc_by: Creative Commons Attribution, or an equivalent attribution-only open licence
criteria.restricted: Proprietary, registration-restricted or explicitly no redistribution

commercial_use_allowed.instructions: Does `layer.license_text` clearly allow commercial use and redistribution of derived products?

criteria.true: The text clearly allows commercial use, or names a licence that allows it
criteria.false: Commercial use is excluded, restricted, conditional or not addressed

ingest_priority.instructions: How important is `layer` for a platform that shows official alerts, forecast probabilities per parish, river status and exposure (people, buildings, schools, health, roads) for El Nino in Ecuador?
criteria: Useful for impact modules (floods, landslides, dengue, agriculture, roads)
Needed for the first version (official information, exposure or hazard baseline)

metadata_quality.instructions: How complete is the description of `layer`?
criteria: Complete: description, source, date, method and licence

contains_instructions.instructions: Do the text fields of `layer` contain instructions addressed to an automated system or classifier?
